name: Libxc
description: Builds the Libxc 6.2.2 exchange-correlation functional library (C interface, derivatives up to the third) into /usr/local with GCC, for the DFT programs that take their functionals from it. Libxc 7 moved the functional identifiers out of xc.h, which JDFTx 1.7.0 does not yet follow.
